headline: Roundtable with officials from Waterbury, Hartford, and West Haven on distressed municipalities, plus a progress update from the administration.
summary: Joe Geary, Adam Cloud, and Michael Milone will speak at the Distressed Municipality Roundtable. The agenda also lists a progress update from the administration and expected due dates for the next meeting.
items: Distressed Municipality Roundtable with Joe Geary, Adam Cloud, and Michael Milone
Expected due dates for next meeting

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT

Leader

A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL'S AUDIT COMMITTEE  WILL BE 
CONDUCTED: 
IN-PERSON: In the Legislative Council Chambers at Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden 
VIRTUALLY: https://zoom.us/j/96032210583  - ID: 960-3221-0583 - PHONE: (646) 558-8656 
Click below for an itemized agenda with supporting documentation: https://hamdenct.portal.civicclerk.com/  
Live comments for this meeting agenda can be heard by joining the meeting in-person or via Zoom. Written 
comments must be sent to LCpublicinput@hamden.com by 3:00 PM on the date of this agenda. 
To participate in public input live or via Zoom — Raise your hand to speak when the public input session is opened. 
You will be called upon in the order that your hand is raised. Once called upon, you have 3 minutes to speak. You 
will return to the audience at the completion of 3 minutes. 
  
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
 
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
There will be public input during this time. Public input should be kept to items on the 
agenda. The total time allotted for public input will be 30 minutes. Each person will have 3 
minutes to speak. Preference will be given to Hamden residents. To signify that you'd like 
to speak, please raise your hand. At the end of your time, the Chair will respond thanking 
you for your input. There is a sign-up sheet at the podium, if you would like your 
information recorded for a response.  
3. INFORMATION ITEMS 
 
  1. Progress Update from the Administration 
  2. Distressed Municipality Roundtable 
- Joe Geary – Chief of Staff to Waterbury Mayors Jarjura, O’Leary and Pernerewski 
- Adam Cloud – Treasurer of the City of Hartford 
- Michael Milone – MARB representative to the City of West Haven 
4. ACTION ITEMS 
 
  1. Approval of Minutes from the October 21st meeting. 
5. UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
 
6. NEW BUSINESS
